title: v2 project configuration (.claude/v2.json)
description: What the scripts of the v2 plugin cannot read from git and GitHub. Every key is optional. scripts/lib/config.ts is the reference: it checks the file and names any wrong key.

method.description: How a pull request into the default branch merges. Missing: the merge queue when GitHub has one on the default branch, else a merge commit. Squash and rebase are never used (GOVERNANCE.md rule 1).

blockingWorkflows.description: Workflows whose runs, while not finished (queued, waiting for an approval, in progress), hold every merge into the default branch: a release, for example.

event.description: Only the runs started by this event, e.g. workflow_dispatch.

dir.description: The folder of the preview of an epic. {main} is the main worktree, {repo} its folder name, {epic} the number. Relative paths are relative to the main worktree.

install.description: The install command, run once in a new folder.

installed.description: What the install creates: when it is missing, the install is due.

serve.description: The servers that show the work. Give them ports other than those of the checkout the person runs.

name.description: Used by the page rules and as --<name>=<url> by the scripts.

cwd.description: Relative to the root of the checkout.

pages.description: Where a change shows, in order: a changed file goes to the first rule that takes it; the others are listed as 'no page in the browser'.

root.description: The folder Storybook runs in; importPath of its index entries is relative to it.

groups.description: Folders that make one row each, relative to root, ending in /** with a {name}: src/components/{component}/**.

path.description: One page per file: /{page}, filled with the captures of files; a last segment named index is dropped.

links.description: Or the same pages for every matched file.

command.description: Run with sh in the root of the checkout, { files, base, head, url } as JSON on its input; prints [{ title, links: [{ label, url }], note? }].

ignoreCommits.description: Commit subjects with nothing to test, as regular expressions.

patterns.description: File patterns relative to the root of the repository: ** any folders, * and ? within a folder, {a,b} alternatives, {name} a capture.
